$comment: Single source of truth for the ten MedLab Studio laboratories. Read by the backend (medlab.labs.registry) and the frontend (src/labs/registry.ts).

labs.name: ECG Signal Lab
labs.tagline: Simulate, corrupt, filter and analyse cardiac signals.
labs.description: Generate synthetic ECG signals, add realistic disturbances, apply digital filters and analyse frequencies, R-peaks and heart rate.

labs.name: Medical Imaging Lab
labs.tagline: View, filter and segment medical image data.
labs.description: Inspect medical images, apply filters and study segmentation algorithms on synthetic and public datasets.

labs.name: Cardiac Digital Twin
labs.tagline: Simplified electrical excitation of cardiac tissue.
labs.description: Simulate simplified electrical wave propagation in cardiac tissue and visualise it in 2D, later in 3D.

labs.name: Wearable Sensor Lab
labs.tagline: Motion, pulse and sensor streams with live dashboards.
labs.description: Examine simulated or imported motion, pulse and sensor data with live dashboards and time-series tools.

labs.name: Pharmacokinetics Lab
labs.tagline: Drug concentration over time in compartment models.
labs.description: Simulate drug concentrations, half-lives, clearance and one- or multi-compartment models with repeated dosing.

labs.name: Surgical Training Lab
labs.description: Develop interactive training scenarios for surgical procedures, instrument recognition and process steps.

labs.name: AI Microscopy Lab
labs.tagline: Detect and segment cells, compare models.
labs.description: Detect and segment cells in microscopy images, compare algorithms and analyse model errors with documented metrics.

labs.name: Regulatory Navigator
labs.description: Structure regulatory requirements, link sources and build a traceable requirements matrix for MDR and related standards.

labs.name: Reaction Time Lab
labs.description: Run reaction-time experiments and analyse latencies, spread and measurement error including browser timing limits.

labs.name: Human-Machine Interaction Lab
labs.tagline: Usability, operating errors and cognitive load.
labs.description: Test user interfaces, record operating errors and study usability and cognitive load of medical UI variants.
